SELECT o.id, o.outdoor_ad_id AS outdoorAdId, o.ad_code AS adCode, o.name, o.type,
o.approved_size AS approvedSize, o.actual_size AS actualSize, o.approval_status AS approvalStatus, o.approved_desc AS approvedDesc, o.end_approval_time AS endApprovalTime, o.data_status AS dataStatus, o.archive_version AS archiveVersion, o.chain_hash AS chainHash, o.life_cycle_id AS lifeCycleId, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime,
o.location, o.lng, o.lat,
ar.area_code AS areaCode, ar.area_name AS areaName,
g.grid_code AS gridCode, g.grid_name AS gridName,
u1.user_name AS approvalName, u2.user_name AS createName, u3.user_name AS updateName,
af.id AS attachId, af.attach_file_id AS fileId, af.file_url AS fileUrl, af.file_name AS fileName, af.file_type AS fileType
FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_area ar ON o.area_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN sys_grid g ON o.grid_id = g.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON o.approval_by = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON o.creator = u2.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON o.updater = u3.id LEFT JOIN sys_attach_file af ON o.id = af.ad_id
WHERE o.id = #{reqVO.id}

SELECT ro.order_id AS orderId, ro.order_code AS orderCode, ro.problem_desc AS problemDesc, ro.require_time AS requireTime, ro.create_time AS createTime, ro.update_time AS updateTime, ro.chain_hash AS chainHash, oa.outdoor_ad_id AS outdoorAdId, oa.name AS adName, oa.ad_code AS adCode, sos.name AS orderStatus, su1.user_id AS handlerUserId, su1.user_name AS handlerName, su2.user_name AS createByName FROM rectification_order ro LEFT JOIN outdoor_ad oa ON ro.ad_id = oa.id LEFT JOIN sys_order_status sos ON ro.order_status_id = sos.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON ro.handler_id = su1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON ro.create_id = su2.id WHERE ro.deleted = 0 AND ro.tenant_id = 1 ORDER BY ro.create_time DESC

SELECT ro.order_id AS orderId, ro.order_code AS orderCode, ro.problem_desc AS problemDesc, ro.require_time AS requireTime, ro.handling_desc AS handlingDesc, ro.complete_time AS completeTime, ro.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ro.close_reason AS closeReason, ro.create_time AS createTime, ro.update_time AS updateTime, ro.chain_hash AS chainHash, ro.life_cycle_id AS lifeCycleId,
oa.outdoor_ad_id AS outdoorAdId, oa.name AS adName, oa.ad_code AS adCode,
osi1.id AS prob_primaryId, osi1.file_id AS prob_fileId, osi1.file_url AS prob_fileUrl, osi1.file_name AS prob_fileName,
sos.name AS orderStatus, su1.user_id AS handlerUserId, su1.user_name AS handlerName,
osi2.id AS hand_primaryId, osi2.file_id AS hand_fileId, osi2.file_url AS hand_fileUrl, osi2.file_name AS hand_fileName,
su2.user_name AS createByName, su3.user_name AS updateByName FROM rectification_order ro LEFT JOIN outdoor_ad oa ON ro.ad_id = oa.id LEFT JOIN on_site_image osi1 ON ro.id = osi1.order_id AND osi1.type = 'prob' LEFT JOIN sys_order_status sos ON ro.order_status_id = sos.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON ro.handler_id = su1.id LEFT JOIN on_site_image osi2 ON ro.id = osi2.order_id AND osi2.type = 'hand' LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON ro.create_id = su2.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su3 ON ro.update_id = su3.id
WHERE ro.order_id = #{reqVO.id}
SELECT id FROM sys_area WHERE area_code = #{areaCode}
SELECT id FROM sys_grid WHERE grid_code = #{gridCode}
SELECT id FROM outdoor_ad WHERE outdoor_ad_id = #{outdoorAdId}
